comments.text: Great list. The Wii U is my beloved and I will not stand for any slander. Two games that you missed out on: "Fatal Frame: Maiden of Black Water" and the indie title "Affordable Space Adventures." Both games were master classes in what to do with the Wii U Gamepad when most developers had given up on it. Making the Gamepad the Camera Obscura and making it a dashboard that demanded your attention as much as the TV screen did were innovations that if more devs could emulate in any small way, the Wii U would have gotten a little more love.
